title: Austin Housing: New Homes & Infrastructure
summary:
*   A $290,000 loan was approved to fund vital infrastructure repairs in a northeast Austin subdivision.
*   This funding will enable the construction of 45 new single-family homes in the area.
*   All new homes must meet S.M.A.R.T. Housing standards, indicating a focus on sustainable and affordable development.

BOARD OF DIRECTORS' MEETING
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
MINUTES
THURSDAY, AUGUST 23,2001
The Board of Directors of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened at 3:37
p.m. on Thursday, August 23, 2001 in the Hancock Building Board Room at the Lower Colorado
River Authority, 3700 Lake Austin Blvd. The following agenda were the AHFC items considered by
the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's Board of Directors.
AHFC-1. 
Approval of minutes for Austin Housing Finance Corporation Special Called Meeting of
August 2, 2001.
The minutes for the Austin Housing Corporation Special Called Meeting of August
2, 2001 were approved on Vice President Goodman's motion, Board Member
Wynn's second by a 7-0 vote.
AHFC-2. 
Approve a resolution authorizing the negotiation and execution of a loan with Devonshire
Partners in an amount not to exceed $290,000 for the purpose of repairing infrastructure
in a 45-unit subdivision located in the northeast Austin area, in order to build 45 new
single-family homes under the S.M.A.R.T. Housing standards.
Resolution No. 2001-0823-02 was approved on Board Member Thomas' motion, Vice
President Goodman's second by a 7-0 vote.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 3:44 p.m. was approved on Board Member Griffith's motion,
Board Member Slusher's second by a 7-0 vote.
